purpose: Describe observed timing consistency, timing bands, route-window comparisons and evidence coverage for repeated directional routes in returned vehicle drive history.
primaryGoal: Understand which repeated routes and vehicle-local departure periods have consistent observed durations while distinguishing sample support from descriptive timing and avoiding future-arrival promises.

dataSources.limits: Only cited model ranges and targeted symbol matches inspected, not an exhaustive numerical correctness audit. No calibration, traffic/weather model or runtime prediction proof.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-002 / reuse existing surfaces before introducing composites
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Window, route directory and methodology cards repeat rounded-xl + neutral border/surface + padding. This is local domain composition, not evidence of a missing global card.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consider existing LayoutCard/Card composition only if all source headings, quantities, captions and layout semantics remain intact. Do not add a new ModernCard or speculative shared abstraction.

issues.detail: Up to ten potentially long directional-route names have interval=0 on a narrow chart. TimingBands repeats this and the 12-bin departure profile also forces every label in ProfilePlot:100-105. Potential collision, not observed viewport failure.
issues.fix: Exercise long localized route names at the ten required widths and allocated column widths; if collisions occur, reuse canonical chart label/rotation or accessible table strategy without dropping route data or exports.

issues.detail: EvidenceMetrics receives analysis/locale/timeZone but no retained flag. Its groups reach NestedDrivingBrief with retained=false default, so nested labels can say Returned evidence during a background refresh failure. WindowComparisons:130-153 likewise omits retained. The page/top brief correctly retain and warn.
issues.fix: Propagate state.refreshError != null through the existing domain metric/group props and pass NestedDrivingBrief.retained; preserve all quantities and source scope. Existing shared brief already supports the state.

visualIssues.detail: All eight explanatory icon/heading containers and several panel icons use fixed text-cyan-300 regardless of theme or semantic meaning. This is repeated accent decoration, not neon/glow proof.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted/secondary text and icon tokens for explanatory decoration; reserve semantic accent for meaningful evidence state. Retain eight methodology explanations and localized headings.

visualIssues.detail: Three filled colored series plus additional multi-series charts make palette intensity a review concern. Imports resolve to static CB-safe blue/green/sky-blue, not the opt-in neon palette; grids already have opacity 0.4 and sample bars opacity 0.35. No literal glow or pure-white noise in assigned page source.
visualIssues.fix: Review actual composed themes and chart density; subdue only decorative grid/reference weight using canonical chart tokens. Keep each series distinct, accessible and exported; retain explicit user palette preferences and do not invent a page palette.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-034 / MDC-046 / one existing chart controller
architectureIssues.detail: All three profile plots nest EmbeddedChart with the same arrival-reliability-profile chartKey inside distinct outer ChartContainers. The child prefers its own hidden-series context over the supplied parent state (line 91), so persistence/legend ownership differs from the outer chart keys. Two canonical frames/controllers are present; no runtime collision is claimed.
architectureIssues.fix: Choose one canonical controller per profile while preserving outer stable keys, existing persisted child state compatibility, data alternatives, legends, exports and fullscreen. Use the existing shared API; coordinate persistence migration with integration owner rather than silently changing IDs.

priority.rationale: Preserve a complete descriptive-analysis page. First resolve chart controller ownership and nested retained-evidence labels, then reduce decorative fixed cyan and verify dense mobile charts.
priority.blockingEvidence: Runtime, contrast and mobile behavior are not established; no backend defect, missing endpoint or blanket engineering pass asserted.

sharedChangeAssessment: None demonstrated. Existing NestedDrivingBrief.retained and canonical chart frames can support page/domain corrections. Chart persistence compatibility requires integration review, not a speculative new shared component.

competingImplementations.detail: Legacy MetricCard KPI renderer remains barrel-exported, but the assigned page renders ArrivalEvidenceBrief. ArrivalEvidenceBrief imports its type only. This is source overlap, not evidence that both summaries are mounted or that the old component has no other consumers.
competingImplementations.fix: Retain the mounted OperationalBrief-based path. Do not reintroduce the old KPI grid. Any removal of the alternative requires a separately scoped reference check.
